patterns.note: Full-bleed editorial photography serves as prominent section dividers, creating a magazine-like visual flow between distinct content blocks.
A sophisticated serif font is used for the main logo and select large titles, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and most headings.
A high-contrast black and white base is complemented by a muted, earthy palette of light greys and a warm beige for backgrounds and subtle accents.
The header remains sticky at the top of the viewport, while large, full-bleed hero images scroll up to reveal new content sections below them.
Content is organized into distinct, vertically stacked sections, each often introduced or separated by a large, immersive photograph with overlaid text.

technique_notes: A header element is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility of the logo and navigation elements as the user scrolls.

Large, high-quality photographs are used as full-width background sections, with text content positioned centrally over a semi-transparent overlay. These sections scroll vertically, revealing new content blocks below them, creating a continuous, magazine-like page flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif for prominent titles and logo, with a clean sans-serif for body and supporting text. Hero titles are large (~3-4x body), while other headings are moderately larger (~1.5-2x body).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and comfortable line heights for readability.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, full-bleed editorial photography as primary section dividers creates a strong visual narrative, making the homepage feel like a curated digital magazine. This approach elevates content presentation beyond typical marketing layouts.
